note: Actual shipments exist and are documented, but the direction is mixed and must be read carefully: the 5 dated customs lines visible in the free view are all IMPORTS of mica flakes from Fuzhou, China (HS 25252010), i.e. the company buys raw mica and grinds it. Export activity is supported by the buyer-side aggregates on the same page (Czech Republic, Russia x2, Japan; 10-39 shipments each) but no single dated export B/L line was visible without a paid subscription, so export_status is confirmed at company level while the per-shipment export detail (date/destination/B/L) remains behind the paywall. Declared HS 252510 (crude mica / mica rifted into sheets or splittings) does not match the observed trade code 25252010 (mica powder) — per project rules this is NOT a rejection ground: the company stays in the base, the factual code is 25252010 (mica powder, worked mica), verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Role: manufacturer_trader (grinder of imported mica plus resale). Revenue and export volume: null — not public. No sanctions/court data checked in this pass (out of scope for this role).
